name: Xor
description: The output will be switched on if only one of the signals are on. The output will be switched off if the two signals are the same.
shortDescription: A logic gate that outputs the logical XOR of two input signals.

logicNodes.label: A
logicNodes.description: The first value to perform the logical XOR on.

logicNodes.label: B
logicNodes.description: The first value to perform the logical XOR on.

logicNodes.label: A XOR B
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal if only A is on, or only B is on. The output is off if A and B are both on or off.
